name: cloudlens-frontend-tooling
description: Browser-side test tooling for CloudLens. The application is Python; this file exists so the Playwright suites and the accessibility audit have somewhere to declare their dependencies.
//type: web/assets holds ES modules. Declaring commonjs here -- which `npm init` does by default -- made Node treat every .js in the repository as CommonJS, and the frontend tests that import them with `node --input-type=module` stopped resolving their named exports. 98 of them failed on that alone.
